title: Obi-Wan’s Desperate Message
front_description: Unaware that he is being observed by the inhabitants of Geonosis, Obi-Wan Kenobi transmits a report of great importance to Anakin, intended for a swift re-transmission to Coruscant. "It is clear that Viceroy Gunray is behind the assasination attempts on Senator Amidala. The Commerce Guilds and Corporate Alliance have both pledged their armies to Count Dooku and are forming an..." With that, Obi-Wan breaks off, obviously attacked.
back_description: Ewan McGregor films the scene in front of a blue screen.
